instruction: Star every message in the INBOX folder

rules.sql: select (select count(*) from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 1)) = (select count(*) from messages where folderID = 1);

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding stars to all emails in the INBOX folder (folderID=1). The evaluator checks if at least one message has the 'star' attribute (attributeID=58) set to 1 in the INBOX. Verified from database: INBOX (folderID=1) contains 2 emails, attributeID 58 corresponds to 'star' status.

llm_judge_reasons: SQL query correctly verifies that ALL messages in INBOX are starred by comparing count of starred messages to total message count
Complete coverage: evaluator checks every message in INBOX (folderID=1) has star attribute (attributeID=58, value=1)
Logical correctness: SQL returns 1 if counts match (all starred), 0 otherwise
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure database is flushed before verification
Getter (run_sqlite3) can successfully extract database and execute the query
